name: Lamech
description: Man living at the time before the Flood

points: “And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech”. Didn’t Cain’s side bring forth Lamech? Cain’s side brought forth Enoch, Irad, Lamech. Remember Lamech said if anyone kills me he’ll be avenged seventy and sevenfold. This is a different Lamech; this is Seth’s Lamech.
